name: remote-ssh-webform
description: Build, run and debug classic ASP.NET (.NET Framework Web Forms / Web API) projects under IIS Express from VS Code Remote-SSH, driven by Visual Studio .slnLaunch profiles, and keep Web Forms designer files in sync with the markup.

remoteSshWebForm.solutionPlatform.description: Solution platform for Build Solution (solution platforms are named like "Any CPU", unlike the project platform "AnyCPU").

remoteSshWebForm.restoreBeforeSolutionBu.description: Restore NuGet packages (including packages.config projects) as part of Build Solution.

remoteSshWebForm.debugType.description: MSBuild DebugType. The VS Code 'clr' debugger needs portable PDBs.

remoteSshWebForm.buildProjectReferences.description: Also build referenced projects. Off by default so unrelated breakage elsewhere in the solution can't block a debug session; referenced assemblies must then already exist from a prior solution build.

remoteSshWebForm.buildChangedReferences.description: Before building the profile's projects, build the projects they reference (directly or indirectly) whose files changed since their last build, dependencies first. Unchanged references aren't built. Not needed when buildProjectReferences is on.

remoteSshWebForm.buildBeforeRun.description: Build the profile's projects before Run/Debug.

remoteSshWebForm.additionalMsbuildArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to every MSBuild invocation.

remoteSshWebForm.msbuildPath.description: Full path to MSBuild.exe. Empty = locate via vswhere.

remoteSshWebForm.iisExpressPath.description: Full path to iisexpress.exe. Empty = %ProgramFiles%\IIS Express\iisexpress.exe.

remoteSshWebForm.applicationPool.description: IIS Express application pool for the generated sites.

remoteSshWebForm.bindAllHostnames.description: Bind sites to all hostnames ("*:<port>:") so they answer on the machine's IP/hostname, not only localhost. Needs a URL reservation when VS Code isn't elevated; the extension tries to add one.

remoteSshWebForm.stopSitesWhenDebuggingS.description: Stop the IIS Express sites once every debug session started by Debug Profile has ended.

remoteSshWebForm.startupTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for each IIS Express site to report it is running.

remoteSshWebForm.generateDesignerOnSave.description: When an .aspx, .ascx or .master file is saved, update its .designer.cs/.vb with a field for each server control, as Visual Studio does.
